design:
D1 Hazard and rollback (Tier 2). New: a model reads operator-supplied text, which is untrusted, and its answer becomes files in the working tree. There is no migration: the job is a registry entry in code and its row is created by the Manager page as for titles, and facts are files. Rollback is a revert. Fact files left behind are plain JSON under knowledge/facts, which the previous Hub never reads (vault._ids lists only sources/). The bundle reaches :8000's app on its next reload; with an old Hub behind it, entries carry no kind and the tab treats them as sources.

D2 Citations: the quote from the model, the lines from the Hub (operator, 2026-10-09). The prompt asks for verbatim quotes. The Hub searches the source for each quote, exactly first, then with whitespace runs collapsed, and records the 1-based line span of the first match. A fact with an unfound quote is dropped and counted in the firing's detail. Rejected: line numbers from the model, which nothing checks; a quote without lines, ambiguous when a sentence repeats.

D3 Background, plus a Distil button (operator, 2026-10-09). The upload route hands the distillation to the event loop after answering. One distillation per source runs at a time (a per-source lock); a second request for the same source waits for the first. A distillation interrupted by a restart is lost; the button recovers it. Rejected: synchronous (the upload hangs for tens of seconds), a durable queue table (a migration and a scheduler for little gain).

D4 Runner, model and pieces (operator, 2026-10-09). The job's model, else its runner's, like titles. There is no agent fallback because there is no conversation. Pieces of 50,000 characters, the vault's page size, cut at the last line break before the limit.

D5 Through worker.run_worker. It already runs a one-shot with no tools, in a temporary directory rather than the project, validates the answer against a Pydantic model, records a worker invocation, and bounds concurrency. A prompt injection in a source can make the model write a wrong fact, but it can act on nothing, and every fact it writes must quote text that is in the source. Each piece is also recorded as a manager firing for the activity log.

D6 Replace on success. Facts carry made_by.job and their source; a distillation that stores at least one fact deletes the source's earlier facts after writing the new ones, so a failed or empty run never loses facts. The storage protocol gains delete.

D7 A private source's facts follow it (roadmap D3). The stub names the holder and the source ids, never the claim: a claim is the knowledge itself.

D8 The map needs no regeneration step. It is built from files on every read, so facts join it by being written. Entries gain kind, and facts are listed after the sources they cite in the same newest-first order.

lifecycle: When closed, this change folds into the knowledge-vault capability, and the roadmap's distillation slice is then done.
problem: The vault (knowledge-vault capability) holds sources, but an agent that needs one business rule must find the right source in the map and read all of it, and the map says only what each source opens with. The roadmap's distillation slice (spdoc-7c75066d6403, slices[2]) turns sources into facts: short claims an agent can find in the map and trust because each one points at the exact place in the source it came from. The manager framework (hub/hub/manager.py) and the vault's storage (hub/hub/vault.py) exist; nothing yet reads a source with a model.

requirements.rationale: Roadmap D7: each manager job names its runner and model, and a new job is a new registry entry, not a migration (manager.py:44). Unlike titles there is no conversation, so there is no agent whose runner could be borrowed: a job with no runner does not spawn.
requirements.statement: The manager's job registry MUST include vault-distillation (trigger source_uploaded), listed by GET /manager/jobs and disabled with nothing chosen until the operator enables it. A firing MUST use the job's runner, and the job's model when one is set, else the runner's model. With no runner chosen, or a runner that no longer belongs to the project, the job MUST NOT spawn.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-10-09: background plus a Distil button. Roadmap D5: the source is in the map the moment it is uploaded; the model only adds to that floor.
requirements.statement: When POST /vault/sources answers 201 and vault-distillation is enabled with a runner, the Hub MUST distil the new source in the background; the upload's answer MUST NOT wait for any model. When the job is disabled, the upload MUST store the source and spawn nothing.

requirements.rationale: The Distil button catches up a source uploaded while the job was off, after a failed firing, or when a restart interrupted one (operator, 2026-10-09).
requirements.statement: POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/vault/sources/{source_id}/distil MUST answer 202 and distil the source in the background. It MUST answer 404 for an unknown source, and 409 with a reason naming what to do when the job is disabled, has no runner, or the source's text is not on this machine. A distillation that stores at least one fact MUST replace the facts previously distilled from that source; one that stores none MUST leave them as they were.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-10-09: the model gives the quote and the Hub finds the lines, so a citation is checked against the source rather than trusted. Roadmap D1 and D2: one record per fact, rendered for people and for agents.
requirements.statement: Each fact MUST be stored as facts/<id>.json (id fct- followed by 12 hex characters) holding id, claim, citations, visibility, created_at and made_by (job and model). Each citation MUST hold source, quote, line_start and line_end. The model MUST supply the quotes; the Hub MUST locate each quote in the source text, exactly or else with runs of whitespace treated as one space, and record the 1-based lines it spans. A fact any of whose quotes is not found MUST NOT be stored.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-10-09: pieces of 50,000 characters keep a call well inside any model's context (about 12k tokens). Manager D4 and D5: every spawn is one recorded firing, written, empty or failed.
requirements.statement: A source MUST be read in pieces of at most 50,000 characters, split at line boundaries, one spawn per piece. Each spawn MUST be recorded as one manager_job_fired event with job vault-distillation, subject {"source": <id>}, the runner, the model, its outcome (written when it stored at least one fact, empty when it stored none, failed when the spawn failed or its answer did not parse), a detail naming the facts stored and the facts dropped for an unfound quote, and its usage.

requirements.rationale: Roadmap D3: a tracked fact never cites a private source, and a private entry is listed as a stub naming its holder.
requirements.statement: A fact distilled from a private source MUST be private: its record written at the effective private location, and only a stub (id, kind, visibility, holder, created_at, sources) written as knowledge/facts/<id>.json, holding no claim and no quote. A tracked fact MUST NOT cite a private source.

requirements.rationale: Roadmap D8: agents find entries through the map. The map is built from the files on every read (knowledge-vault), so a new fact is in it with no regeneration step.
requirements.statement: Every map entry MUST carry kind, source or fact. A fact entry MUST carry sources (the ids it cites), and its opening MUST be its claim, or null when the fact is a stub whose record is not on this machine. GET /vault/entries/<fact id> and vault_read MUST answer the fact with its claim and each citation's source, quote and lines as its content.

requirements.rationale: The slice's done criterion: facts show in the wiki beside their sources, each linking to the right place in the transcript.
requirements.statement: The Vault tab MUST show, on a source, the facts distilled from it, each with its claim and a link to its citation; following the link MUST show the source's text with the cited lines highlighted. A source MUST offer a Distil button, which calls the distil route and shows its refusal reason when it answers 409.

in_scope: A vault-distillation manager job, off until the operator enables it, bound to a runner and model on the Manager page
Distillation in the background after an upload, and on demand through a distil route and a Distil button
Fact records: one file per fact, with its claim and citations (source, quote, line range), tracked or private like the source
Facts in the map and through vault_read, beside sources
The Vault tab: a source's facts, each linking to its cited lines highlighted in the source
non_goals: Contradictions between facts, and any merging or de-duplication across sources (contradictions slice)
Agent reports about wrong facts (agent-reports slice)
Editing or deleting a fact by hand
A durable queue that survives a Hub restart: the Distil button recovers an interrupted distillation
Committing the files: the operator's git flow commits knowledge/

summary: A new manager job, vault distillation, reads each new vault source and writes the facts it states (business rules, decisions, limits) as fact records. Each fact cites the exact quote it rests on and the lines of the source where that quote sits. The model supplies the quote, and the Hub finds it in the source and records the lines, so a fact cannot cite text that is not there. The job runs in the background after an upload, and a Distil button on each source runs it again. Facts appear in the map and in the Vault tab beside their source; a fact from a private source stays private. Tier 2: a model spawned on untrusted operator-supplied text, writing files into the working tree and the private location.
